newsitem.title: USA: PACE Health Management signs clinic pact.
newsitem.headline: PACE Health Management signs clinic pact.

text.p: PACE Health Management Systems Inc said Tuesday it will install its Critical Care System in the Intensive and Coronary Care units of Iowa Methodist Medical Center in Des Moines.

Once installed, the system will help clinicians coordinate patient care using real-time status information on patients, PACE said. The company said the system is fully integrated with other modules of the PACE Care Management System.
PACE designs and installs patient care management software for the health care industry.
Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 2-1/4.
